protocol.architecture: two-level U-Net, widths16/32/64 by default, GroupNorm/GELU, max-pool, transpose-convolution upsampling, skip concatenation
protocol.confidence_intervals: paired whole-field percentile bootstrap, conditional on these trained networks
protocol.normalization: coefficient and target statistics fit on training fields only
protocol.optimizer: Adam, lr0.001 by default, cosine schedule to fixed final epoch
protocol.selection: 200 fixed epochs by default; no fresh-label tuning, validation selection, or early stopping
